function.description: Primary entry tool for discovery job summaries and discovery history. Use this first for broad discovery-history questions, current-user discovery history, user-filtered discovery history, recent discovery activity, failed or completed discovery lists, and date-range discovery questions. Also use this first for IP-only discovered-device checks where the user gives a device identifier or management IP address but no discovery name. For IP-only checks, use this response to obtain discovery id/jobId pairs, then call api_getDiscoveredNetworkDevicesBySettingsId with managementIpAddress for each relevant job. Do not use api_getAllDiscoveryDetails for broad summary/history or IP-only workflows. Do not use this tool for named discovery workflows where the user explicitly supplies a discovery name; named discovery count, device-list, or detail workflows start with api_getAllDiscoveryDetails.
function.name: api_getDiscoveryJobsSummarys

name.description: Optional name of the discovery to filter by. This supports partial search. For example, searching for "Disc" will match "Discovery1", "Discovery2", etc.

offset.description: The first record to show for this page. Minimum value is 1

order.description: To fetch the latest discovery job.  use the order query parameter with values such as asc or des. By default, jobs are ordered by descending order to display the most recent entries first.

orderBy.description: To fetch the latest discovery job.  use the orderBy query parameter with values such as lastUpdatedDate, startTime and endTime. By default, jobs are ordered by lastUpdatedDate display the most recent entries first.
